description: Team IMPULSE is six students from India, named for the signal rather than the silence. We build for the browser: 3D scenes, real-time rendering, front-end, and the writing that holds it together. For NASA Space Apps we chose "Abandoned but not Forgotten" because it is a storytelling problem disguised as a data problem — retroreflectors still answering lasers from Earth. We built a 3D web experience you can explore: click an object, learn what it was, when it was left, and why it still matters.
